name: Andhra University Online

about.text: Andhra University was established 97 years ago in 1926 by the Madras Act and is one of the oldest and most esteemed educational institutions in India. It has been ranked as the 43rd best university in India by the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF). The university has been awarded an A grade by the National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC) and approved by the University Grants Commission (UGC) to offer its courses in the online mode.

The university currently offers bachelor's degrees, a BCom (Accountancy), and a master's degree (M.A. Sociology) as part of its online programs to students. It provides quality study material like e-books, study guides, recorded tutorials, and live lectures to students, along with carrying out regular practice tests and discussion forums so that the students can gain maximum value from the university.

about.text: Overall, Andhra University constitutes 5 colleges and 4 campuses. Out of which the College of Arts and Commerce is the largest one, consisting of 26 internal departments that provide courses in 42 different subjects, including diplomas. The College of Science & Technology has more than 21 different departments offering 63 study programs and a PG diploma. While the College of Engineering includes 15 departments offering UG, PG, and research programs.

The university has various colleges, out of which the College of Pharmaceutical Sciences is the most unique type in South India, offering one undergraduate and six postgraduate programs. Andhra University provides its own Learning Management System (LMS) to students to support the journey of their online education and provide them with the best guidance and curriculum.

facts: Andhra University was established in 1926 under the Madras Act of 1926 and holds its place as one of the oldest and most prestigious universities in India.
Andhra University has been ranked as the 25th best university in India by the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF).
The university has been accredited by the National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC) with an A grade.
All the courses are approved by UGC to be offered in online mode.
The university offers a B.Com undergraduate degree course and an M.A. Sociology postgraduate degree course in the online mode.
Students are given admission to online courses on a provisional basis after university counselling and approval.
Students are given access to learning material such as e-books, study guides, practice tests, discussion forums, web resources, live interactive sessions, etc.

emi.text: The online programs offered by Andhra University are cost-effective and affordable compared to the traditional regular courses. Apart from the fee, the other expenses are minimal.

admission.text: The admission process for Andhra University takes place in online mode. Fresh admission starts in the month of January of every year. There are direct admissions, and no entrance exam is conducted for the admission process. The admission procedure for 2026 for the online courses at Andhra University is as follows:
Step 1: Visit the official website of Online Andhra University and begin the application process by clicking on “Apply Now.”
Step 2: Enroll yourself in the course you want to study by filling in the required details and paying ₹500 as registration fees.
Step 3: After submission of the registration fees, the university verifies the documents of the prospective students and further approves the students for completion of the admission process.
Step 4: After the document verification, the approved students can complete the admission process by completing the fee payment through the payment gateway.
Step 5: After final verification by the university and fee payment, the admission process will be complete, and the students will be given access to their Learning Management System.

examination.text: Andhra University conducts exams in the online mode for its online programs on its own Learning Management System, which is remotely proctored. The university conducts regular evaluations during the session and final exams at the end of each semester. This helps students to stay connected with the learning process throughout the session.
Examination Pattern: 30-40% Internal Assessment (assignments, quizzes, participation) + 60-70% End-Semester proctored online exam. No physical exam-centre visit required.

faqs.q: What are the learning resources provided by Andhra University for Online Education?
faqs.a: Andhra Online University gives access to top-quality course material to its students. These include e-books, study guides, practice tests, discussion forums, web resources, tutorial videos, live interactive sessions, and animated modules.
